onset_metric: independent source MIDI, one-to-one 50 ms matching; thresholds selected on development only
limitations: The held data is the old preliminary BabySlakh diagnostic and has been used by earlier feasibility work; it is not an untouched acceptance set.
Only the output head was tuned. The frozen training run used no held labels, thresholds, or intervals.
No BASS, cymbal, grid F1, ARM latency, incremental RSS, or redistribution claim is made.
The base ADTOF port/weight licensing remains unresolved for shipment.
interpretation: This bounded transfer experiment did not resolve TOM: development F1 remains 0.0984 and old-held diagnostic F1 is 0.0290. It is evidence about this frozen head-only transfer configuration, not a conclusion about all model architectures.
